**Role: Technology Lead \- IdentityNow**
**Job Summary**
 The IdentityNow Security Senior Analyst role will be primarily responsible for leading support team that is delivering and supporting software that are critical pieces of the IdentityNow SaaS solution, the daily operations support, enhancements, and review of the Identity Management application and underlying infrastructure, also adhering to stated SLA’s and ensuring high standards for quality in regard to project documentation.

* Should have experience on IdentityNow SaaS solution L2/L3 support
* Will be responsible for applications onboarding
* Facilitate project activities by managing risk and issue mitigations, establish project schedule, and manage change controls.
* Partner with Product Management to ensure your team has clear tactical and strategic backlogs
* Balance competing priorities to ensure we effectively ship new features while resolving defects and managing technical debt
* Recruit, coach, develop, and motivate high performing engineers
* Proactively seek to listen and find alignment with other engineering teams and stakeholders by understanding your team's technology, building strong relationships, and insisting on high\-quality solutions
* Deep knowledge of SaaS products, agile processes (Preferably SCRUM) and workflows, and experience implementing them
* Technical experience and fluency at the product/solution/architecture level, enabling easy discussions with engineers
* An exceptional mentor and leader with a passion for continuous improvement
* Experience in implementing /supporting at least two IAM engagements including application support (IdentityNow / other IAM)
* Experience in technologies, such as Java, Ldap, RDBMS and Linux.
* Good knowledge of Web/application servers (IIS, WebSphere WebLogic, JBoss and Apache)
* Experience in development configuration of standard custom IAM integrations using java or other major scripting languages.
* Experience in hands on development, estimations, sizing and custom IAM integrations.
* Advanced documentation and presentation skills and well\-versed with SDLC process.
* Exposure to process frameworks and methodologies.
* Should have experience in interacting with Clients, including working with client teams in an onsite and offshore delivery model.
* Automating of manual tasks performed by administration team.
* Customize, configure, and develop IdentityNow solution integrations using requirements and design and independently manage project deliverables to successful completion.
* Troubleshoot IdentityNow Issues


**Qualifications**
**Education**
* Bachelor or college degree in related field or equivalent work experience


**Work Experience**
* 5\-10 years’ experience


**Skills Expertise:**
* IdentityNow managed support experience and application onboarding
* Knowledge on Java, Scripting knowledge like PowerShell, Perl etc
* Good soft skills i.e., verbal \& written communication, technical document writing etc
* Exposure to global security standards e.g., PCI, SOX, HIPAA etc
* Prior experience working in remote teams on global scale.
* Customer orientation skills.


**Certification:**
* SailPoint Certified IdentityNow Engineer (Good to have)


**Work Requirements:**
* Willingness to be on call support
* Willingness to work in 24\*7 rotational shifts as required


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

title: Service Monitoring Engineer
description:
**Join our Team**
-----------------


**About this opportunity**


We are now looking for a **Service Monitoring Engineer** to join our Network Operations team at Ericsson. In this role, you will be part of a global operations environment ensuring network stability, performance, and customer satisfaction through jeopardy management of the incidents.  

You will play a key role in tracking, and driving timely closure of incidents, service requests, and operational tasks to ensure network availability is maintained at the target levels. This will require coordination with the Field, 3PP \& Internal Ericsson team. This position provides an exciting opportunity to work with diverse network technologies while contributing to Ericsson’s vision of a fully connected, intelligent world.

 **What you will do**

* Continuously track incidents, service tickets, and operational activities.
* Conduct regular follow\-ups with responsible teams to ensure progress towards timely closure.
* Initiate recovery actions when timelines slip or risk indicators arise.
* Validate updates and ensure all incidents have clear actions, owners, and deadlines.
* Responsible for delivering the necessary reports required for the Jeopardy Management of the incidents \& as defined and requested by customer.
* Apply the defined escalation matrix based on severity, impact, and aging of incidents.
* Ensure adherence to jeopardy management policies, workflows, and SLAs.
* Provide regular status updates to stakeholders regarding jeopardy items and escalated issues.
* Prepare incident summary reports, escalation logs, and closure metrics for leadership review.
* Track and report KPIs such as aging incidents, SLA compliance, escalation count, and closure rate \& blockers/reasons for slow progression.
* Maintain dashboards or trackers that highlight jeopardy status and follow\-up progress.
* Support audit requirements with proper documentation and data accuracy.
* Assist in identifying and implementing process improvements to reduce incident occurrence and impact.

 **The skills you bring**

* 2–6 years of experience in Network Operations / Alarm Monitoring in a telecom or IT network environment.
* Strong understanding of general network technologies and concepts across access, transport, and IP domains (vendor\-agnostic).
* Hands\-on experience with Ericsson OSS/NMS tools or other multi\-vendor management systems (e.g., Netcool, HP OpenView, SolarWinds, etc.).
* Knowledge of fault management processes, ITIL best practices, and SLA\-driven operational models.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to quickly interpret incidents and determine probable actions needed to resolve the same.
* Excellent communication and coordination skills for effective collaboration across global teams.
* Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication abilities.
* Skilled in handling escalations and managing political dynamics in high\-stakes scenarios.
* Hands on analytical tools like MS Excel, MS Power Point, MS Power Bi.
* Ability to work in a 24x7 shift environment (rotational shifts, weekends, and holidays).
* Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Electronics, Computer Science, or equivalent.

 **All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification**

**Why join Ericsson?**At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

Join Ericsson as an Engineer – Data Centre, an integral role where you will have the opportunity to manage, maintain, and deployment of the physical infrastructure within the data centre. This role involves both building and operational support activities to ensure optimal data centre performance and reliability. The engineer will be actively involved in activities such as rack installation, cable laying, network device installation, cable dressing, and material handling. In addition, the role includes troubleshooting hardware and connectivity issues, coordinating with customers and OEM vendors, and ensuring all incidents are resolved within defined SLA timelines.

 **What you will do:**

* Help the installation of data centre devices (Arista, Juniper, Cisco, Ciena, Nokia) and infrastructure by guiding the field team to fully understand the entire scope.
* Address technical queries and provide solutions to ensure smooth execution of field work.
* Collaborate with the customer to identify and resolve any discrepancies in the detailed document aligned with the scope of work.

* Contribute to POC and document drafting related to the process methodology.
* Ensure field technicians receive ongoing skill development through new training programs.
* Stay current with the latest technologies and best practices in the data centre industry.
* Involvement in the upcoming decommissioning efforts, in tendum with the build team, will include dismantling equipment, acquire packaging materials, and handle the entire process through customer portals.
* Work in collaboration with the project manager on upcoming projects and submit technical quotations based on the customer\-defined scope of work for invoicing.

* Proven experience in installation, commissioning, and decommissioning of hardware within data centre environments.
* Proven experience in remote troubleshooting and ability to operate effectively in a data centre environment.
* Strong technical expertise in data centre operations and IT infrastructure, including servers, switches, routers, cabling systems, and fibre optics.
* Demonstrated ability to manage and maintain physical infrastructure within a data centre environment.
* Strong hands\-on experience and in\-depth understanding of Cisco, Ciena, Juniper, and Arista network devices and technologies.
* Strong expertise in optical, copper, and fibre cabling systems, including fibre standards, connector types, and cable management practices.
* Flexible and adaptable, capable of working both independently and as part of a collaborative team.
* Skilled in reviewing, enhancing, and maintaining Methods of Procedure (MOPs) and operational guidelines.
* Strong focus on service excellence with a customer\-first mindset, leveraging multi\-domain technical competence.

title: Tower Lead - ServiceNow
description:
**Hello,**
**FCM part of FCTG** 
 is one of the world’s largest travel management companies and a trusted partner for nationals and multinational companies. With a 24/7 reach in 97 countries, FCM’s flexible technology anticipates and solves client needs, supported by experts who provide in\-depth local knowledge and duty of care as part of the ultimate personalised business travel experience.
   

  

 As part of the ASX\-listed Flight Centre Travel Group, FCM delivers the best market\-wide rates, unique added\-value benefits, and exclusive solutions.
   

  

**Winner of the World's Leading Travel Management Company Award at the WTM for nine consecutive years (2019\-2011\),** 
 FCM is constantly transforming the business of travel through its empowered and accountable people who deliver 24/7 service and are available online and offline. FCM has won the coveted
 **Great Place to Work certification for the fifth time** 
 ! FCM Travel India is one of India’s Top 100 Great Mid\-size Workplaces 2024 and the Best in Professional Services.
   

  

 A leader in the travel tech space, FCM has proprietary client solutions. FCM provides specialist services via FCM Consulting and FCM Meetings \& Events.
   

  

**Summary**
 The ServiceNow Tower Lead is the assistant team leader for the ETS ServiceNow team, responsible for the end\-to\-end delivery of ITSM support, project engineering, and platform maintenance, based in the Global Capability Centre. The Tower Lead operates with a high degree of independence, owning solution design and delivery for standard BAU and ITSM work, and coordinating with onshore design leads for major or complex projects where additional design authority is required.
   

  

 Operating within the SIAM framework as part of an internal service provider function, the Tower Lead enables the offshore team to function as a capable, self\-directing delivery unit — maintaining quality, throughput, and platform standards with little routine onshore dependency. The Tower Lead is a senior technical practitioner who leads by example, uplifts team capability, and holds full delivery accountability within the offshore context.
   

  

**Day In The Life**
**Offshore Delivery Leadership**
* Lead and coordinate the offshore ServiceNow development team across BAU support, project delivery, and platform maintenance workstreams.
* Manage daily stand\-ups, sprint ceremonies, and team workflow, driving a high\-performing delivery cadence with minimal onshore direction required.
* Act as the primary escalation point for the development team, resolving blockers and maintaining momentum through active, technically\-grounded leadership.
* Allocate work across the development team based on capacity, skillset, and priority, optimising throughput without compromising quality.
* Foster a culture of ownership and continuous improvement within the team, setting clear expectations for delivery standards and individual accountability.


**Solution Design and Technical Authority**
* Own end\-to\-end solution design for all BAU ITSM work and small projects, translating business requirements into well\-defined technical specifications and acceptance criteria without requiring onshore input (except where a Technical Business Analyst is also assigned).
* Engage with internal business customers to understand requirements, conduct discovery, and propose fit\-for\-purpose ServiceNow solutions aligned to platform best practices and FCTG standards.
* For major or complex projects, receive design artefacts and functional specifications from design leads, interpret these accurately, and direct the team in executing against the agreed design.


**You'll Be Perfect For The Role If You Have**
**BAU Support Coordination**
* Oversee the offshore team's response to BAU ServiceNow support tickets, ensuring SLA adherence and customer experience standards are maintained independently of onshore involvement.
* Triage incoming support requests, assign to appropriate developers, and track resolution to closure.
* Identify recurring issues or systemic defects and initiate remediation or platform improvement actions within the team's remit, escalating only where broader platform decisions are needed.
* Maintain awareness of platform incidents and manage support team contribution to resolution activities.


**Testing and Release Coordination**
* Oversee the QA function and ensure test plans, test cases, and defect tracking align to agreed acceptance criteria and standards.
* Coordinate release packaging and submission through ETS change management processes, ensuring all governance requirements are met prior to deployment.
* Ensure all release artefacts, documentation, and post\-release validation activities are completed to standard.


**Governance and Reporting**
* Maintain accurate sprint and delivery reporting to support visibility of the team's productivity, quality, and capacity.
* Contribute to standards, documentation, and knowledge base maintenance in Confluence, ServiceNow and Sharepoint.
* Adhere to change management, release, and governance processes as defined by FCTG, ensuring relevant activity is auditable and compliant.


**Work Perks! \- What’s in it for you:**
 FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.
   

  

 You will be rewarded with competitive market salary. You will also be equipped with relevant training courses and tools to set you up for success with endless career advancement and job opportunities all over the world.
   

  

**Market Aligned remuneration structure** 
 and a highly competitive salary
   

  

**Fun and Energetic culture** 
 : At the heart of everything we do at FCM is a desire to have fun and be yourself
   

  

**Work life Balance** 
 : We believe in “No Leave \= No Life” So have your own travel adventures with paid annual leave
   

  

**Great place to work** 
 \- Recognized as a top workplace for 5 consecutive years, which is a testimonial of our commitment towards our people
   

  

**Wellbeing Focus** 
 \- We take care of our employee with comprehensive medical coverage, accidental insurance, and term insurance for the well being of our people.
   

  

**Paternity Leave:** 
 We ensure that you can spend quality time with your growing family
   

  

**Travel perks** 
 : You'll have access to plenty of industry discounts to ensure you continue to broaden your horizons
   

  

**A career, not a job** 
 : We believe in our people brightness of future. As a high growth company, you will have the opportunity to advance your career in any direction you choose whether that is locally or globally.
   

  

**Reward \& Recognition** 
 : Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering \- You'll have to experience it to believe it!
   

  

**Love for travel** 
 : We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
   

  

**We value you...**
 Flight Centre Travel Group is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace that supports your unique identity to create better, safer experiences for everyone. We encourage you to come as you are; to foster inclusivity and collaboration. We celebrate you.
   

  

**Who We Are...**
 Since our beginning, our vision has always been to open up the world for those who want to see.
   

  

 As a global travel retailer, our people come from all different backgrounds, and our connections spread to the far reaches of the globe \- 20\+ countries and counting! Together, we are a family (we call ourselves Flighties).
   

  

 We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve. We embrace new experiences, we celebrate the wins, seize all opportunities, and empower all of our people to find their
 **Brightness of Future.**
 We encourage you to
 **DREAM BIG** 
 through collaboration and innovation, and make sure you are supported to make incredible ideas a reality. Together, we deliver quality, innovative solutions that delight our customers and achieve our strategic priorities.
   

  

**Irreverence. Ownership. Egalitarianism**
